name: iMessage Generator
summary: Insert an iMessage-style chat conversation overlay into the current Draft, with optional synced text-to-speech narration (free local Kokoro voices or ElevenLabs cloud voices).

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript/call, generated-media authoring, Project file-tree adapters, and the host FileSystem and bundled ffmpeg (Runtime.runFFmpeg) for narration audio. Local Kokoro voices are macOS-only (runShell + Python); on Windows narration uses ElevenLabs. Released-version and Linux compatibility are unverified.
